messages:
leo: hey team 👋 first-week Q: where do I grab a sandbox key vs a hosted/prod key? also who signs off when I need a prod key or a temporary bump for a live demo?

ana: welcome! sandbox keys are auto-provisioned on signup and live in Console -> Sandbox. Hosted/prod keys are created by org admins in Console -> API Keys and are billing-enabled.

ops: for prod keys that include sensitive scopes (customer-data, export), the flow is: 1) org admin creates key 2) request security review (email security@redwood.com) 3) attach justification + owner + runtime where key will be used. Security will add audit entry and approve.

leo: thanks. and demo bumps — can I get a short burst increase for a presentation?

devex-bot: Yes. For demo/stage bumps open a ticket at https://go/redwood-help -> choose "Sandbox/demo quota" and include time window + expected traffic. Ops typically issues time-limited elevated keys (10-30 minutes) after approval.

ana: pro tip: use the staging org or a time-limited demo key for live demos. Watch for 429s and the Retry-After header. Implement exponential backoff: wait_ms = 500 * 2**attempt.

ops: default new-hire sandbox: $30 promo credits and ~50k tokens/month (soft). Rate-limits: ~12 reqs/sec steady per key; short bursts allowed up to ~48 reqs/sec for a few seconds. These vary by cohort.

leo: who can approve higher sustained quotas (e.g., >200k tokens/month)?

ops: for sustained increases include a short justification and expected monthly token volume in the ticket. We require ops lead sign-off for >200k and may request architecture/ cost owner review. Expect 1-2 business days.

ana: small security reminder — never commit keys. Use env var REDWOOD_API_KEY or Vault. For CI, use secrets manager. If a key is leaked, rotate it and ping security immediately.

leo: awesome, saved. I'll open the ticket for a 15-min demo bump. Thanks! :thumbsup:
